transport.title: Metro
transport.text: Metro line 10 serves both terminals; in Terminal 2, access is on Level B2 through passages L2, L3 and L4. Shuangliu Airport Terminal 2 East station is served by lines 19 and 30, with access through passage L3 on Level B2 of Terminal 2. Line 19 connects it with Tianfu Airport Terminal 1 & 2 and Tianfu Airport North.

taxi.title: Taxi
taxi.text: At Terminal 1, the taxi rank is about 50 m south, outside door 6 on the arrivals level. At Terminal 2, boarding is near the pedestrian crossing on the arrivals level; the transport supervision telephone number is 12328.

terminals.title: Between terminals
terminals.text: A free bus operates between Terminals 1 and 2, while the walk takes about 8–10 minutes. The Terminal 1 stop is on the south forecourt outside door 3; the Terminal 2 stop is on the north forecourt outside door 9.

storage.title: Baggage storage
storage.text: Terminal 1 baggage storage is north of security area B; Terminal 2 storage is behind check-in island P. Both open 2 hours before their terminal’s first departure and close after its departures finish. A small locker costs CNY 8 for up to 6 hours, CNY 13 for up to 12 hours and CNY 18 for up to 24 hours, then an additional CNY 2 for each subsequent 6 hours; periods under 6 hours are charged as 6 hours. Valid ID is required at drop-off and baggage is screened; collection requires the receipt and the same ID presented at drop-off. Power banks and lithium batteries are not accepted for storage.
